messages.body:
Hi all,

as discussed: near-patient testing by health professionals is not self-testing. Under your Edition 3 table, S25 applies to Kestrel-3 (professional near-patient use) while S08 and S26 stay out unless a self-test variant is filed. The Home concept is not part of this file.

Colm
